beats.text: To prove his strength, Rama shot one arrow through seven giant sal trees, and it came back to his quiver.
Sugriva challenged Vali to a duel. Vali, the mightiest monkey, was said to take half the strength of any enemy who faced him.
The two looked alike, and Rama hesitated to shoot, fearing he might hit the wrong one. Sugriva fled, bleeding.
The next day, Sugriva wore a garland of flowers as a mark.
Vali's wife Tara begged him not to fight. 'Sugriva has a new ally. Rama.' Vali did not listen.
This time Rama's arrow flew true from behind a tree, and Vali fell.
Vali asked, 'Why strike from hiding?' Rama explained his duty: Vali had taken his brother's wife, and a king must punish that.
Vali accepted, and asked Rama to protect his son, Angada. Sugriva was crowned king of Kishkindha.
